title: Multi-contrast MRI INR with compact contrast Givens views

prior_art.official_code: No public code repository found in bounded search; no acquired PREDICTOM data is available in the workspace.

hypothesis: For one synthetic MPnRAGE-like slice with complementary undersampling across eight inversion contrasts, a shared spatial INR plus two learned Givens angles per contrast reconstructs all contrasts within 1% NMSE of the native continuous-TI shared INR while reducing complete payload bytes by at least 25% versus per-contrast FiLM and at least 50% versus independent INR models.
physical_object: shared spatial implicit neural field and output head
mirror_coordinate: two contrast-specific Givens angles rotating paired latent channels
logical_multiplicity: eight contrast-specific logical images from shared spatial parameters
scope: bounded analytic synthetic mechanism screen; not a reproduction of PA306 and not a patient/acquired MRI study

data.type: analytic synthetic inversion-recovery brain-like tissue map
data.undersampling: complementary 6/24 Cartesian phase-encode lines per contrast; 2 center lines shared; 5 lines train, 1 disjoint acquired line held out per contrast
data.ground_truth_use: post-fit scoring only; no ground truth in reconstruction objective

controls: native coordinate-conditioned shared INR using continuous normalized TI input
shared spatial INR plus per-contrast ordinary FiLM coefficients
shared spatial INR plus two learned Givens Mirror angles per contrast
eight independent per-contrast spatial INR fits

training.updates_per_method: 300 joint updates for each shared method; independent control gets 300 updates per contrast (2,400 total optimizer steps), reported as the native independent upper control.
training.selection: fixed one-shot schedule; no hyperparameter adjustment after results
training.objective: sum of normalized measured k-space MSE over only training lines; holdout lines used for scoring

metrics: image NMSE and PSNR against hidden analytic truth
actual serialized full eight-contrast inference payload bytes

storage.common_schema: identical architecture/measurement metadata fields; charge all learned tensors and contrast codes

success_gate: Mirror relative NMSE no more than 1% worse than native continuous-TI INR; actual payload at least 25% below FiLM and 50% below independent; heldout acquired residual no more than 1.1x native.
failure_gate: FAIL if Mirror misses quality or storage gates, loses to native coordinate conditioning at similar cost, or has worse heldout data consistency.
boundaries: No acquired MRI, PREDICTOM subject data, coil maps, or clinical result.
One analytic tissue map and eight contrasts only; no anatomy generalization.
No capacity claim; one fixed synthetic development run.
failure_gate_result: FAIL at development: Mirror NMSE 2.6464 is 131.4% worse than native continuous-TI INR (1.1438), heldout k-space RMSE .1530 vs .1338 (>1.1x gate), and complete payload 26,117 B vs 26,309 B FiLM (0.73% saving versus required 25%). Fresh remains unopened.

compute.mirror_rotation_ops_proxy: two Givens pairs per voxel per contrast, 8 contrasts; plus shared MLP
